# Cambium

> Android NIP-55 signer proxy that holds no user keys. It answers NIP-55 intents, content-provider queries and `nostrsigner:` web links by forwarding signing and encryption to a paired Heartwood hardware signer over NIP-46 (Nostr relays). Kotlin, Gradle, package `dev.forgesworn.cambium`, MIT licence.

- [README](https://github.com/forgesworn/cambium/blob/main/README.md): what Cambium is, the security model, pairing from Sapwood, approval controls, phone unlock, install and build.

## NIP-55 integration contract

See [For client developers](https://github.com/forgesworn/cambium/blob/main/README.md#for-client-developers) in the README. In short:

- Visible path: `Intent.ACTION_VIEW` on `nostrsigner:<payload>` with `setPackage("dev.forgesworn.cambium")` and extras `type`, `id`, `current_user`, `pubkey`, `permissions`. Result extras: `result`, `id`, `event`, `signature`, `package`, `rejected`.
- Silent path: `content://dev.forgesworn.cambium.<METHOD>` for `SIGN_EVENT`, `NIP04_ENCRYPT`, `NIP04_DECRYPT`, `NIP44_ENCRYPT`, `NIP44_DECRYPT`, `DECRYPT_ZAP_EVENT` and `PING`. Arguments go in `projection` as `[payload, otherPubkey, currentUser]`. A `null` cursor means use the intent; a `rejected` column is a terminal refusal; a row with empty `result` and `error` = `signer unavailable` is terminal and must not fall back to the intent.
- Websites: `nostrsigner:<percent-encoded payload>?type=...&callbackUrl=...&returnType=signature|event&compressionType=none|gzip`. Always a one-shot approval; the callback must be HTTPS (or loopback HTTP).
- Batches: `FLAG_ACTIVITY_SINGLE_TOP | FLAG_ACTIVITY_CLEAR_TOP` queues up to 32 requests and returns a `results` JSON array.

## Build

- Dependency versions: [gradle/libs.versions.toml](https://github.com/forgesworn/cambium/blob/main/gradle/libs.versions.toml) is the source of truth.
- Unit tests (JVM only): `./gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest`. Debug APK: `./gradlew :app:assembleDebug`. Requires JDK 21 and `sdk.dir` in `local.properties`.

## Optional

- [Sapwood](https://github.com/forgesworn/sapwood): manages Heartwood and issues the `bunker://` pairings Cambium consumes.
- [Heartwood](https://github.com/forgesworn/heartwood-esp32): the hardware signer Cambium pairs with.
